The minimatch fix is no longer on the default branch. Commit `5ba5b70` (PR #3433, ticket O3-5781) bumped three pinned minimatch versions, and commit `07236b4` (PR #3442) reverted it.

**What the change did**

- minimatch 3.1.2 → 3.1.5 (the `^3.x` range, requested by e.g. `glob` and `ignore`)
- minimatch 5.1.0 → 5.1.9 (the `^5.x` range)
- minimatch 9.0.5 → 9.0.9 (the `^9.x` range), which also moved its `brace-expansion` requirement from `^2.0.1` to `^2.0.2` and added a `brace-expansion@npm:^2.0.2` entry resolving to 2.1.1.

The PR said these addressed GHSA-23c5-xmqv-rm74, GHSA-3ppc-4f35-3m26 and GHSA-7r86-cg39-jmmj, all High severity. Its title and body link the ticket O3-5781.

**How the lockfile picked them up**

No manifest changed. `package.json` only has `resolutions` for `sass` and `dompurify`. The commit touched only `yarn.lock` (19 additions, 10 deletions). Per the PR description, the stale entries for the three versions were removed so `yarn install` re-resolved each range to the newest patch within its major. The diff shows that as in-place version and checksum edits to those three entries, plus the new `brace-expansion` entry.

**Current state**

The revert `07236b4` (PR #3442) restored the old entries, along with the other OWASP-related commits it lists (`fca099e`, `5ba5b70`, `3484232`, `4d80520`). In the current `yarn.lock`, the `^5.0.1` entry is back at 5.1.0 and `^9.0.5` at 9.0.5. The `^3` entry shows 3.1.5, but I did not check which later change put it there. The reverted commit `fca099e` (PR #3436, O3-5782) was a broader pass that also used `resolutions`; I did not inspect its contents.
